The local recipient model replaces each complete supplied Product body, excluding its independently tracked TradeItem collection, and replaces each supplied complete TradeItem. Unlisted CHANGE records persist. This is an explicit materialization policy; the cited guideline does not specify a field-by-field patch protocol.
